nodes.label: Reconciliation Worker - Background polling for pending IRIS booking cases
Background worker for reconciling pending IRIS booking cases.      Implements:
Start the reconciliation worker background task
Process a single reconciliation case.          Args:             db: Database se
Handle confirmed IRIS booking success.          Updates journey state to ABONADO
Handle confirmed IRIS booking failure.          Transitions to terminal failure
Escalate case to operator after max retries exceeded.          Marks case as esc
Check if case should be retried based on exponential backoff.          Args:
Start the global reconciliation worker instance
Stop the global reconciliation worker instance
